I will split one bag of NPK fertilizer with my brother because one full bag is too much money and too much quantity for my small plot of 0.21 hectare. I will also spread manure from my goats on the land since I have some behind the house and it makes the soil soft. I will plant the same local rice seed I kept from last year; I do not trust those new hybrid seeds that the agro-dealer sells. My wife and children will do the weeding, bird chasing, and harvesting, so I do not need to pay anyone to work on this plot.
